mavito.heading: Featured project

mavito.roleBody: Sole developer and founder: product, design, frontend, backend, database, deployment, and operations.
features: QR digital menu with branded design
Kitchen display (KDS) with live order status and timers
Waiter tablet ordering with item notes and split payment
Inventory with recipes and automatic raw-material deduction and low-stock alerts
Customer club with loyalty points and campaigns
Finance: cashier, expenses, profit and loss, daily and monthly reports
